Hiii, because of all the attacks and wars we are planning on relocating back to my home country. We were in the process of getting the partner visa for over a year now and our interview appointment is finally scheduled for august this year. I am aware that it is bad to leave the country while being in a visa process, but I would just like to know how to do this in the best way possible.

I want to still be able to visit and meet up with all the family and friends I now have in Israel. What would be the best moment to leave visa-wise? While I'm still waiting for the interview, or after I receive the visa? And how can I still enter Israel as a tourist or maybe restart the visa process in the far future? Do we need to inform piba about this choice? If you have any information please let me know, thank you!🙏
